definitions.sun_elevation: topocentric apparent Sun centre elevation, observer R + h0 + 2 m, no refraction
definitions.sunset: first minute after landing when < 50 % of the solar disc is above the real terrain mask (core.js sunlit rule)
definitions.ephemeris: card 1 pipeline (NAIF DE440s + MOON_ME DE421 via Skyfield)

robotic_sunset.landing_source: ISRO (landing 23 Aug 2023 18:03-18:04 IST; date confirmed in the ISRO post quoted below)
robotic_sunset.reported_event: lander set into sleep mode (operator decision before local sunset; rover slept 2 Sep)
robotic_sunset.source_quote: ISRO post embedded on the page: 'Vikram Lander is set into sleep mode around 08:00 Hrs. IST today' (4 Sep 2023)
robotic_sunset.source_kind: agency statement (ISRO post), via news page
robotic_sunset.proxy_note: End of operations is an approximate proxy for local sunset, not an exact measurement.
robotic_sunset.difference_text: our sunset minus reported event: +3.8 h
